name: Zinda Pakadna Hai Bhosdiwalo Ko
visual_description: Kaleen Bhaiya (Pankaj Tripathi) in Mirzapur pointing forward intensely against a wall painted with a Buddha sketch.
usage_context: Used to express wanting to catch someone red-handed or pursue a culprit for payback after they cause chaos.

example.top_text: When your friend takes the last slice of pizza and tries to run away

text_areas.description: Caption describing the target who needs to be caught
